_what: the nine feedback reports from staff

reports.summary: I can see who corrected a clock-out and when without calling the shop. Payroll hours took me half the time this period. Thank you.
When the new week comes out my phone goes off five times, once for every day. One buzz with the whole week would do me fine!
it wont let me fix yesterdays clock out. the question was there this morning then it was gone after i clocked in
Opening a chat with photos in it takes forever on the counter computer. Customer is standing there and I'm watching it spin.

Asked what front pads and rotors cost and it gave me {ledger:s12.brake_price.stale} from the old brake page. The price list says {ledger:s12.brake_price.now}. It should know which page is the price list.
Planner says 3 unpublished and I can't tell which 3. Let me print the week like I used to.
I would like to put the customer on a calendar entry. The Millsaps vans come every Monday at opening and all I can do is type their name in the title.
A new chat alerts all of us at once, and twice this week two of us answered the same customer. Could it go to whoever is on the desk first?
A no-show gets flagged and I can't find where. I learned Austin was out from the counter at 8:15, not from the app. Put it in my Inbox.

notes.s10: FB1, FB2 and FB3 are card S10's three: the Wednesdays of weeks T-12, T-7 and T-2
